items.title: Meghan says she was informed about 'disturbing allegations' against her father in 2018

items.title: Meghan's father investigated by police over child sex abuse image claims

items.title: Terrorist shooting in Paris suburb marks 'turning point for France', Macron says

items.title: Detective raped by colleague says Met handling of case 'like being raped again'

items.title: What is in the Be Ready checklist as Britons urged to stock up to survive potential cyber or climate emergencies?
items.summary: The British public is being urged to stockpile food, water and emergency supplies as part of national efforts to prepare the UK for any potential crises.
